photos.c: Facing the stiffest opposition, the 800 metre boys kept the win record going. Spencer Barden, Dean Clark, Clive Gilby and Steve Baldock on the rain-swept podium
Below: Ignoring the pouring rain at the end of the race. Lee Hurst, Paul Freary, Spencer Barden, Jason Lobo, Paul Evans and Mark Miles.

Above: Irish eyes were not the only ones smiling when the the Belgrave team collected their prizes in Wallace Park. Rob McHarg, Paul Freary, Alaster Stewart, Yacin Yusuf (crouching), Jason Lobo and Spencer Barden enjoy being Irish Road Relay Champions.

Belgrave's Winning AAA 12-Stage Team at Sutton Park. Back row: Andy Graffin, Spencer Barden, Paul Freary, Stephen Sharp, Alaster Stewart, David Anderson, Allen Graffin, Paul Evans. Front row: Lee Hurst, Mark Miles, Alan Mead (team manager), Richard Ward, Charles Herrington.

Above (1): Belgrave's men retained the AAA 6-Stage Road Relay Championship at Sutton Park in October 2002. Mark Miles, Richard Ward, Spencer Barden, Stephen Sharp, Allen Graffin and David Anderson celebrate keeping hold of the trophy for another year. This is the hardest team title to win - can they make it three in a row in October 2003?
Top left: Spencer Barden took the Bels into a lead on stage 3 that they were never to lose.

Above: Stephen Sharp (stage 6), Phil Wicks (2), Jonathan Blackledge (5), Spencer Barden (4), Alaster Stewart (1) and Tim Watson (3) receive the Ian Logan Trophy – Belgrave’s fourth year of being top of the pile at Rushmoor Arena.  Only Stephen and Jonathan remained in the squad from 2004’s winning line-up.
Above: Spencer Barden takes the tape for Belgrave’s fifth consecutive National 6-Stage Road Relay win. Photo by Mark Shearman.
